subject.title: fix(anthropic): keep OAuth callback on loopback

question: Should Anthropic OAuth reject all non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values while keeping the provider-visible redirect URI fixed to http://localhost:53692/callback?
rationale: The patch narrows an auth-provider environment surface and relies on a provider redirect contract that source inspection and mocked token tests cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept After Real Proof
options.body: Resolve the proof gap, keep the loopback-only bind host plus fixed localhost redirect contract, and land this as the candidate fix for the linked security report.

options.title: Require Stronger Provider Proof
options.body: Ask for live Anthropic or installed-client proof that the fixed localhost redirect is accepted for supported loopback bind hosts before merge.

options.title: Pause For Auth Redesign
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer removing or redesigning the Anthropic callback-host override instead of hardening it in place.

recommendation.title: Accept After Real Proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the proof gap, keep the loopback-only bind host plus fixed localhost redirect contract, and land this as the candidate fix for the linked security report.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the latest commits that set the current bind-host and redirect contract.
